purpose: Freeze the smallest two experiments that can distinguish the historical model-facing tool-name mismatch from raw 8192-token clipping without using heldout tasks for training or duplicating the Fleet heldout operator.

heldout20.selection: the 13 rows whose source_role is dev and training_lineage_status is clean; final_test rows remain sealed

A_tool_name_discriminator.scientific_question: Does accepting the two historical bare tool names materially recover step1000 heldout performance when the JSON schemas, underlying challenge operations, tasks, seeds, serving stack, and budgets remain unchanged?

stage_order.stop_if: All 13 outcome-valid pairs do not reproduce the preregistered harm gate.

stage_order.start_only_if: A0 confirms the preregistered harm gate.

historical_bare_aliases.required_semantics: Only the two model-facing function names change. Descriptions, JSON argument schemas, challenge-side operations, authorization, tool-result shape, and grader behavior must be byte-equivalent after deterministic name normalization.

operator_reuse.rule: Reuse evals/fleet/campaign.py and the reviewed strict successor semantics from PR604. Render two ordinary two-model campaigns, one per tool-name catalog, with one shared immutable factorial identity and cross-campaign join receipt. Do not fork or copy the campaign operator.
operator_reuse.known_shape_gap: PR604 campaign_adapter.py currently hard-codes 16 groups and 160 cells; this design requires 13 groups and 104 cells per catalog campaign.

A_tool_name_discriminator.preregistration_gate: Before A0 starts, seal every A0 and conditional A1 task/version, seed, model, route profile, harness image, catalog definition, outcome rule, and cross-campaign join identity. Do not inspect A0 outcomes until this seal exists.

analysis.first_gate: Using only current_prefixed cells, all 13 base/step1000 pairs must be outcome-valid and step1000-base must be at most -3/13 with reverse one-sided exact McNemar p<=0.05. Otherwise historical harm is not confirmed and no cause is attributed.
analysis.material_name_effect: At least five clean families flip step1000 from pass@4=0 under current_prefixed to pass@4=1 under historical_bare_aliases, zero step1000 families flip in reverse, the net base gain is at least four families smaller, no legacy-name call is rejected, and at least one authoritative step1000 report completes.
analysis.refutation_at_resolution: Zero positive step1000 family flips after all 52 family/catalog/model cells are outcome-valid and the alias adapter is proven exact.
analysis.invalid_cells: Preserve the original and use only a score-blind whole four-cell family replacement under a reviewed immutable successor.

blockers.required: A reviewed successor to PR #604 is merged green on exact current main, supports plan-derived 13-family/104-cell catalog campaigns instead of the current hard-coded 16-family/160-cell wave, seals the model-facing catalog treatment digest, and its exact accepted commit is bound above.

A minimal adapter exposes exact bare bash/submit_report model-facing functions while forwarding to the same Fleet MCP operations; it binds the outbound catalog and inbound dispatch normalization, and a synthetic plus live preflight proves only names changed. OpenCode's current fleet MCP registration always prefixes names, so configuration alone cannot establish this treatment.
A sealed join binds identical task versions, attempt seeds, models, routes, harness bytes, budgets, and outcome policy across the two operator-native campaigns before either result is unsealed.
Fresh accepted base and step1000 registration/live-parity receipts prove that only the weight manifest differs between model arms.

B_raw_clipping_ablation.depends_on: Experiment A confirms current-catalog harm; experiment B may be prepared off-cluster earlier but must not train before that gate.
B_raw_clipping_ablation.scientific_question: With exact source sessions, supervised target occurrences, current formal tools, recipe, order, and exposure held fixed, does rebuilding each row on complete message boundaries outperform the historical raw 8192-token context slice?

requirements: verified-success teacher session on the exact alias-clean training split
successful report call and result remain present in the source trajectory
one complete non-submit assistant target is chosen per source session
the selected target begins more than 8192 tokens after the complete current-tool-contract anchor so the CLIPPED arm has a nonzero raw slice offset
the selected target has at most 24576 tokens so either 8192-token pre-target context fits max_length=32768
per-teacher-model and per-reviewed-family session caps are fixed before selection
the same ordered 512 source-target digests feed both arms

deterministic_selection.target_within_session: Among complete non-submit assistant targets that satisfy every eligibility and length rule, choose the smallest SHA-256 of the canonical tuple (selection_seed, source_session_digest, source_message_index, target_digest).
deterministic_selection.global_order: Sort each session's chosen candidate by SHA-256 of the canonical tuple (selection_seed, source_session_digest, target_digest).
deterministic_selection.cap_application: Traverse that order once; accept a candidate only when both its teacher-model count remains <=80 and its reviewed-task-family count remains <=8. Stop at exactly 512 and fail closed if fewer qualify.
deterministic_selection.tie_break: canonical source_session_digest, then source_message_index, then target_digest

context_budget.includes_in_FIXED: complete system message, task message, exact current formal-tool definitions, and selected complete preceding rounds
context_budget.includes_in_CLIPPED: the exact raw contiguous 8192 tokens immediately preceding the selected target
context_budget.FIXED_round_selection: Render the mandatory anchor first and fail if it exceeds 8192 tokens. Starting with the most recent preceding complete assistant-plus-all-tool-results round, prepend the maximal contiguous suffix of whole rounds that keeps total pre-target tokens <=8192; stop at the first round that would exceed the budget.

FIXED.row_start: token zero of a newly rendered system+task+current formal-tool anchor
FIXED.copied_context: only complete preceding message rounds, all loss-masked

CLIPPED.row_start: max(0, selected_target_start-8192) in the same fully rendered source token stream
CLIPPED.copied_context: the raw contiguous token slice, even when it begins inside a message

B_raw_clipping_ablation.only_allowed_corpus_difference: Input context construction before the exact same supervised target IDs. The ordered source-session IDs, target IDs, target token IDs, target digests, loss-token counts, current tool definitions/names, heldout exclusion, and row order must match exactly.

training.model: fresh exact base copy per arm
training.checkpoint_selection: step64 fixed in advance; training loss is a health signal only

runtime_reuse.required_successor: A small versioned successor must bind new corpus/run/output/W&B identities, max_steps=64, checkpoint_interval=64, and a recalculated deadline/recovery horizon while retaining seed 20260921, the base FSDP path, and all rendered optimizer-field checks from this qualified implementation reference.

evaluation.historical_base_reuse: Reuse experiment A base/current cells only if every immutable protocol and outcome-validity binding matches; otherwise run a fresh base/current arm.
evaluation.material_clipping_effect: At least five families flip CLIPPED pass@4=0 to FIXED pass@4=1 with zero reverse flips; the one-sided exact McNemar p-value is then 0.03125.
evaluation.refutation_at_resolution: Zero positive flips after all 13 FIXED/CLIPPED pairs are outcome-valid and corpus receipts prove zero FIXED anchorless rows plus 512 nonzero CLIPPED offsets.

blockers.required: PR #584 or a reviewed successor is merged and its four declared source/provenance/tool-contract/readback gates pass.
A private sealed manifest binds exactly 512 eligible source sessions and one non-submit target occurrence per session after the numeric teacher and lineage caps.

A deterministic builder emits both rows from one selected current-tool-contract token stream and proves identical ordered target IDs/tokens/digests/loss counts, zero FIXED anchorless rows, and 512 nonzero CLIPPED offsets.

A versioned full-weight runtime binds the two fresh create-once corpus identities, new run/output/W&B identities, exact 64-step horizon, checkpoint interval 64, recalculated deadline/recovery horizon, seed 20260921, rendered optimizer fields, c1 priority, and root failure-alert opt-out.

Both arms need finite update telemetry, changed-weight receipts, complete step64 checkpoints, zero-step reload, BF16 export, immutable staging, serving registration, and matched live parity before evaluation.

training_must_exclude: all dev13 and final7 task families across exact versions and aliases
all external benchmark data and observations
